qualifications.releaseState: QUALIFYING. Automated checks do not qualify external services or release channels.
qualifications.xcodeIOSBuild: Full Xcode app and simulator builds are not run by the portable verifier. Run native CI and verify again on the release Mac.
qualifications.physicalIPhone: signing, installation, iOS 26 and iOS 27 behavior, iPhone 18 Pro Max on-device Foundation Models, lower-device Shortcut fallback, device lifecycle, and hardware acceptance are not run by the portable verifier
qualifications.liveAppleSignIn: web standalone, link, refresh, conflict, and revocation flows are not run without production Apple identifiers, secrets, domain, and accounts
qualifications.liveAppleNativeExchange: native nonce exchange, bearer expiry, revocation, and device lifecycle are not run against the production Apple and hosted services
qualifications.nativeDeviceProtection: Face ID, passcode, locked-device files, Files-provider protection, and iCloud Keychain recovery require physical-device qualification
qualifications.liveEncryptedSync: cross-device recovery, pagination under live mutation, conflict review, key loss, and service transport are not run against production accounts
qualifications.nativeBackgroundProcessing: BGProcessingTask scheduling, expiration, lock deferral, resubmission, and exactly-once completion require physical-device qualification
qualifications.providerShortcuts: portable checks cover the five-probe verifier, device-local signed-ledger types, deterministic ranking, strict routing receipts, and eight provider selections; iPhone 18 Pro Max offline Foundation Models, lower-device Siri/App Shortcut discovery, provider-owned app sessions/actions, daily probe timing, signed Shortcut packages, text return, and foreground handoff still require installed signed device builds
qualifications.liveGitHubSync: dashboard proxy, direct browser access, native access, and non-force writes are not run with a live repository token
qualifications.liveCursorOrigin: installation, repository discovery, mirror refresh, and disconnect are not run without production Cursor application credentials and a permitted repository
qualifications.browserLifecycle: Safari Home Screen installation, persistence, suspend and resume, offline behavior, quota failure, and multi-tab recovery require target-device testing
qualifications.staticSelfHostDeployment: archive contracts do not replace an HTTPS deployment smoke test of the generated static self-host package
qualifications.accessibilityAndDeviceMatrix: VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, landscape, iPad, touch targets, and the requested device matrix require real UI testing
qualifications.githubRelease: source publication and release workflow configuration are not performed by verification
qualifications.appStoreAndTestFlight: archive upload, TestFlight acceptance, metadata, submission, and App Review are not performed by verification
